name: Frappe Bench
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y openssh-server wget && sudo mkdir -p -m 755 /etc/apt/keyrings && tmp_keyring=$(mktemp) && wget -nv -O "$tmp_keyring" https://cli.github.com/packages/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg && cat "$tmp_keyring" | sudo tee /etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg >/dev/null && rm -f "$tmp_keyring" && sudo chmod go+r /etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg && sudo mkdir -p -m 755 /etc/apt/sources.list.d && echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg] https://cli.github.com/packages stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/github-cli.list >/dev/null && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y gh
updateContentCommand: mkdir -p ~/.ssh && chmod 700 ~/.ssh && if [ -f ~/.ssh/authorized_keys ]; then chmod 600 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys && sudo sed -i 's/#\?PubkeyAuthentication.*/PubkeyAuthentication yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && sudo sed -i 's/#\?PasswordAuthentication.*/PasswordAuthentication no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && sudo sed -i 's/#\?PermitRootLogin.*/PermitRootLogin no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config; else echo 'No ~/.ssh/authorized_keys found; skipping SSH configuration.'; fi
postStartCommand: if [ -f ~/.ssh/authorized_keys ]; then sudo service ssh start; else echo 'SSH is disabled because ~/.ssh/authorized_keys is missing.'; fi && (grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])development[.]localhost([[:space:]]|$)' /etc/hosts || echo '127.0.0.1 development.localhost' | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts >/dev/null) && cd /workspace/development/frappe-bench && bench set-config -g webserver_host 127.0.0.1 && bench set-config -g webserver_port 8000 && bench set-config -g socketio_port 9000
